payload.scope_note: Navigation cluster for the SU(3)_2-related AnyonWiki FR_6_1_4_5 F/R data, including cat_1_3_1 and cat_1_3_2 source captures, balancing and Hopf/S checks, and the scalar-gauge equivalence claim. It groups evidence; it is not a standalone theorem.
upstream_review_hints: Relevant generated artifacts include experiments/results/anyon-wiki-su3-2/su3-2-anyonwiki-candidate-check-v1.json, su3-2-anyonwiki-hopf-check-v2.json, and su3-2-anyonwiki-cat-1-3-1-vs-cat-1-3-2-gauge-check-v1.json.
